```{r}
# Import the required packages
packages <- c("rmarkdown","knitr","corrplot","viridis","basicPlotteR")
for (p in packages) {
  if(!require(p, character.only=TRUE)) {
    install.packages(p)
  }

}
rm(packages, p)
```

# Helper functions

```{r}
panel_cor <- function(x, y, digits=2, prefix="", cex.cor=1.6, ...)
{
  usr <- par("usr"); on.exit(par(usr=usr))
  par(usr=c(0, 1, 0, 1))
  r <- cor(x, y, use="complete.obs")
  txt <- format(c(r, 0.123456789), digits=digits)[1]
  txt <- paste(prefix, txt, sep="")
  text(0.5, 0.5, txt, cex=1.3)
}

panel_hist <- function(x, ...)
{
  usr <- par("usr"); on.exit(par(usr=usr))
  par(usr=c(usr[1:2], 0, 1.5) )
  h <- hist(x, plot=FALSE)
  breaks <- h$breaks; nB <- length(breaks)
  y <- h$counts; y <- y/max(y)
  rect(breaks[-nB], 0, breaks[-1], y, col="black")
}
```

# PPMT transform functions

```{r}
# Normal Quantile Transform
nqt <- function(x, k=30) {
  require(mgcv)

  y <- qqnorm(x, plot.it=FALSE)$x
  m1 <- gam(y ~ s(x, bs="cr", k=k))

  y <- predict(m1, newdata=data.frame(x=x))
  m2 <- gam(x ~ s(y, bs="cr", k=k))

  score <- function(x) {
    y <- predict(m1, newdata=data.frame(x=x))
    return(y)
  }

  iscore <- function(y) {
    x <- predict(m2, newdata=data.frame(y=y))
    return(x)
  }

  return(list(score=score, iscore=iscore))
}
```

```{r}
ppmt <- function(x) {
  # Zscore 1.
  #z_norms1 <- lapply(x, nscore)
  #z_nscore1 <- sapply(1:ncol(x), function(i) z_norms1[[i]]$score)
  z_nqt1 <- lapply(x, nqt)
  z_nscore1 <- sapply(1:ncol(x), function(i) z_nqt1[[i]]$score(x[[i]]))
  z_nscore1 <- as.data.frame(z_nscore1)
  names(z_nscore1) <- names(x)

  # Sphereing
  z_cv <- cov(z_nscore1)
  z_ei <- eigen(z_cv)
  V <- z_ei$vectors
  z_W <- V %*% diag(1 / sqrt(z_ei$values)) %*% t(V)
  z_A <- solve(z_W)
  z_sphere <- as.matrix(z_nscore1) %*% z_W
  z_sphere <- as.data.frame(z_sphere)
  names(z_sphere) <- names(x)

  # Projection pursuit.
  #z_pp <- fastICA::fastICA(z_nscore1, ncol(x), alg.typ="deflation", fun="logcosh",
  #                         alpha=1, method="C", row.norm=FALSE, maxit=100,
  #                         tol=1e-2, verbose=FALSE)
  require(ica)
  z_pp <-  icafast(z_sphere, ncol(z_sphere), center=FALSE,
                   alg="def", fun="logcosh")
  z_S <- as.data.frame(z_pp$S)
  names(z_S) <- names(z_sphere)

  # Zscore 2.
  #z_norms2 <- lapply(z_S, nscore)
  #z_nscore2 <- sapply(1:ncol(z_S), function(i) z_norms2[[i]]$score)
  z_nqt2 <- lapply(z_S, nqt)
  z_nscore2 <- sapply(1:ncol(z_S), function(i) z_nqt2[[i]]$score(z_S[[i]]))
  z_nscore2 <- as.data.frame(z_nscore2)
  names(z_nscore2) <- names(x)

  #y <- list(z_norms1=z_norms1, z_sphere=list(W=z_W, A=z_A),
  #          z_pp=z_pp, z_norms2=z_norms2, X=x, Y=z_nscore2)
  y <- list(z_nqt1=z_nqt1, z_sphere=list(W=z_W, A=z_A),
            z_pp=z_pp, z_nqt2=z_nqt2, X=x, Y=z_nscore2)

  return(y)
}

ippmt <- function(x, ppmt, method=c("back", "interp", "MBCn")) {
  method <- match.arg(method, c("back", "interp", "MBCn"))

  f.back <- function(x) {
    # Zscore 2 inverse.
    #y <- sapply(1:ncol(x), function(i) nsbacktr(x[,i], ppmt$z_norms2[[i]]))
    y <- sapply(1:ncol(x), function(i) ppmt$z_nqt2[[i]]$iscore(x[,i]))

    # Projection pursuit inverse.
    #y <- y %*% ppmt$z_pp$A
    y <- tcrossprod(y, ppmt$z_pp$M)

    # Sphereing inverse.
    y <- y %*% ppmt$z_sphere$A

    # Zscore 1 inverse.
    #y <- sapply(1:ncol(y), function(i) nsbacktr(y[,i], ppmt$z_norms1[[i]]))
    y <- sapply(1:ncol(y), function(i) ppmt$z_nqt1[[i]]$iscore(y[,i]))

    y <- as.data.frame(y)
    names(y) <- colnames(ppmt$Y)

    return(y)
  }

  f.interp <- function(x) {
      require(FNN)

    k <- ncol(x)
    nn <- get.knnx(df.ppmt$Y, x, k=k, algorithm="kd_tree")

    y <- sapply(1:nrow(x), function(i) {
      w <- 1 / nn$nn.dist[i,]
      w <- w / sum(w)
      y <- t(df.ppmt$X[nn$nn.index[i,],]) %*% w
      return(y)
    })
    y <- as.data.frame(t(y))
    names(y) <- names(x)

    return(y)
  }

  f.MBCn <- function(x) {
    require(MBC)
    u <- MBCn(as.matrix(df.ppmt$X), as.matrix(df.ppmt$Y), as.matrix(x),
              iter=30, silent=TRUE, ratio.max=1, trace=0.01)

    return(u$mhat.p)
  }

  y <- switch(method,
              back = f.back(x),
              interp = f.interp(x),
              MBCn = f.MBCn(x))

  y <- as.data.frame(y)
  names(y) <- names(x)

  return(y)
}
```

```{r}
panel_points <- function(x, y, ...)
{
  i <- complete.cases(cbind(x, y))
  x <- x[i]
  y <- y[i]

  z <- densCols(x, y, colramp=colorRampPalette(c("black", "white")))
  cols <- viridis(256)

  df <- data.frame(x, y)
  df$dens <- col2rgb(z)[1,] + 1L
  df$col <- cols[df$dens]
  df$pch <- 20

  o <- order(df$pch, -df$dens, decreasing=TRUE)
  df <- df[o,]

  points(y~x, data=df, pch=pch, col=col, cex=1.2)
}
```

# Load data

```{r}
data(jura, package="gstat")
df <- jura.pred
df_flds <- c("Cd","Co","Cr","Cu","Ni","Pb","Zn")
n <- nrow(df)
```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 3
#| fig.width: 3
#| fig.cap: "Correlation plot of Jura assay data."
x <- df[, df_flds]
y <- cor(x, use="pairwise.complete.obs")
corrplot(y, tl.cex=0.7, tl.col="black", insig="blank")
```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 6.7
#| fig.width: 6.7
#| fig.cap: "Pairs plot of Jura assay data."
pairs(df[, df_flds], upper.panel=panel_cor, diag.panel=panel_hist, lower.panel=panel_points)
```

# Perform transform

```{r}
df_ppmt <- ppmt(df[, df_flds])
```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 3
#| fig.width: 3
x <- df_ppmt$Y
y <- cor(x, use="pairwise.complete.obs")
corrplot(y, tl.cex=0.7, tl.col="black", insig="blank")
```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 6.7
#| fig.width: 6.7
pairs(df_ppmt$Y, upper.panel=panel_cor, diag.panel=panel_hist, lower.panel=panel_points)
```

# Perform independent estimation or simulation

```{r}
set.seed(1)
n <- 1000
df_new <- matrix(rnorm(n*length(df_flds)), nrow=n)
df_new <- as.data.frame(df_new)
names(df_new) <- df_flds
```

# Back-transform

```{r}
df_newt <- ippmt(df_new, df_ppmt, method="back")
```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 3
#| fig.width: 3
x <- df_newt
y <- cor(x, use="pairwise.complete.obs")
corrplot(y, tl.cex=0.7, tl.col="black", insig="blank")
```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 6.7
#| fig.width: 6.7
pairs(df_newt, upper.panel=panel_cor, diag.panel=panel_hist, lower.panel=panel_points)
```

# Assess difference in correlation

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=4}
#| fig.height: 4
#| fig.width: 4
x <- cor(df[, df_flds], use="complete.obs")
x <- x[lower.tri(x)]
y <- cor(df_newt, use="complete.obs")
y <- y[lower.tri(y)]
flds <- outer(df_flds, df_flds, paste, sep=".")
flds <- flds[lower.tri(flds)]
lim <- range(x, y)
par(mar=c(5.1, 4.1, 1.1, 1.1))
plot(x, y, pch=16, cex=0.5, xlim=lim, ylim=lim,
     xlab="Actual", ylab="Simulated")
abline(0, 1, col="red")
addTextLabels(x, y, cex.label=0.7, cex.pt=1, col.line="blue",
              col.label="blue", labels=flds, keepLabelsInside=TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 4
#| fig.width: 4
require(MBC)
u <- MBCp(as.matrix(df_ppmt$X), as.matrix(df_ppmt$Y), as.matrix(df_new),
          iter=100, silent=TRUE, ratio.max=1, trace=0.01)
u <- u$mhat.p

x <- cor(df[, df_flds], use="complete.obs")
x <- x[lower.tri(x)]
y <- cor(u, use="complete.obs")
y <- y[lower.tri(y)]
flds <- outer(df_flds, df_flds, paste, sep=".")
flds <- flds[lower.tri(flds)]
lim <- range(x, y)
par(mar=c(5.1, 4.1, 1.1, 1.1))
plot(x, y, pch=16, cex=0.5, xlim=lim, ylim=lim,
     xlab="Actual", ylab="Simulated")
abline(0, 1, col="red")
addTextLabels(x, y, cex.label=0.7, cex.pt=1, col.line="blue",
              col.label="blue", labels=flds, keepLabelsInside=TRUE)
```
